action: A single left-to-right move past each table: a grandfather reading a Yiddish paper with his lips moving; two Irish girls splitting an apple under the table, passing a penknife; a man in a porter's cap, one finger under the line; a Puerto Rican mother steering two kids to picture books by the backs of their collars; a boy copying a world map from an atlas, tongue between teeth, while a boy a shade darker borrows his eraser without asking and returns it without thanks, and neither looks up; a librarian with spectacles on a chain stamping due dates hard enough to make the pencils jump; a hand-lettered card: FREE CONCERT, CONCOURSE PLAZA, SUNDAY, ALL WELCOME.
